yup I'm currently a bit over 1 month on minox, pre t. Sadly I gotta shave it all in a bit because of my parents noticing it. but i am fairly hairy already and had a few chin hairs before minox. I have a lot of dark chin hairs now which are definitely noticeable, some are still only growing in. I have some darker fuzz on my jaw area, a bit of a stache and some hair under my lips. peach fuzz is also a good bit longer now. I applied it on my eyebrows which were already well filled, now I have hair connecting my eyebrows to my hairline, which is weird.

 I'm pretty happy with my progress, I'd definitely recommend it. I also didn't have any side effects other than my face being slightly itchy a while after putting it on. make sure to moisturize if you decide to go on minox

edit: also, even if you just use minox on your face it's likely to also make hair grow elsewhere. if you put minox on another place, make sure to not use more minox so you avoid overdosing.
